verdict.rationale: Runbooks are FireHydrant's automation engine, and audit logs record Runbook modifications, which gives a change history that can be reviewed after the fact. The API can configure anything the UI can, so teams could version runbook configs externally with their own tooling. There is no evidence of native versioning, change review/approval, or rollback of automations. Missing for 10: native runbook version history, pre-change review/approval workflow, one-click rollback to prior versions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
